title: viola arvensis var. anglica
intro: Viola arvensis var. anglica, commonly known as English wild violet, is a perennial plant species in the family Violaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Viola arvensis var. anglica include its ability to act as an antioxidant, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, as well as anthocyanins and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
